pages.title: Our History
pages.text_en:
HISTORY OF ARUSHA DISTRICT COUNCIL.
Welcome to Arusha Council to learn a brief history of this council including the origin of the council, the size of the area and administrative areas including Wards, Villages, and Hamlets, its boundaries, the geography of its location, administrative leadership, population, residents of Arusha Council, activities that residents engage in, the location of the offices of the Arusha Council headquarters. Along with the Vision, Mission, Goals, and Strategies of the Council for a five-year period.
HEADQUARTERS OF ARUSHA DISTRICT COUNCIL:
The offices of the Arusha District Council headquarters are located in Kiutu Ward, Engorika Village, Sekei area near the Mount Meru International Hotel, approximately 300 meters from the main Moshi – Arusha – Namanga road.
ORIGIN OF ARUSHA COUNCIL:
The Arusha District Council officially started on 01.07.2007 after being separated from the former Meru Council, resulting in two councils of the Council of
pages.text_sw:
HISTORIA YA HALMASHAURI YA WILAYA YA ARUSHA.
Karibu Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arusha kufahamu Historia fupi ya Halmashauri hii ikiwemo Chimbuko lake, ukubwa wa eneo na maeneo ya kiutawala ikiwemo Tarafa, Kata, Vijiji na Vitongoji, mipaka yake, Jiografia ya mahali ilipo, Uongozi kiutawala, Idadi ya watu, wenyeji wa halmashauri ya Arusha, shughuli wanazofanya wenyeji.
CHIMBUKO LA HALMASHAURI YA ARUSHA:
Halmshauri ya Wilaya ya Arusha ilianza rasmi tarehe 01.07.2007 baada ya kugawanywa iliyokuwa Halmashuri ya Meru na kuwa na Halmashauri mbili za Halmashauri ya Meru na Halmashauri ya Arusha. Halmashauri ya Arusha ni miongoni mwa Halmashauri saba za mkoa wa Arusha inayopatikana chini ya Mlima Meru ikiwa imepakana na halmashauri ya Meru kwa upande wa Mashariki, Halmashauri ya Monduli upande wa Magharibi, Halmashauri ya Longido upande wa Kaskazini Magharibi, Halmashauri ya Simanjiro mkoa wa Manyara kwa upande wa Kusini. Halmashauri ya Arusha imelizunguka jiji la Arusha kwa pande zake zote. Halmshauri ya Arusha ina eneo lenye ukubwa wa Kilomita za mraba 1446.692 inapatikana Magharibi mwa mlima Meru wenye urefu wa mita 4,562 kutoka usawa wa bahari ambao ni mlima wa pili kwa urefu Tanzania baada ya mlima Kilimanjaro wenye urefu wa mita 5,890.
Halmashauri ya Arusha imelala kati ya Latitudo 3000- 3040’ Kusini mwa Ikweta na Longitudo 36015’-360 55’ Mashariki. UKUBWA WA ENEO: Wilaya ina eneo la kilomita za mraba 1,446.692. Matumizi makubwa ya ardhi katika Wilaya ni pamoja na: kilimo, makazi, biashara, madini, ufugaji / malisho, utalii wa asili na viwanda vidogo na biashara na hifadhi za misitu. Ambapo, hifadhi ya misitu ina eneo la kilomita za mraba 54.17, ardhi inayofaa kwa kilimo ni Kilomita za mraba 446.56, malisho huchukua eneo la Kilomita za mraba 506.01 sehemu ya ardhi iliyobaki yenye ukubwa wa wastani wa Kilomita za mraba 440.2 inatumika kwa shughuli nyingine kama vile biashara, makazi na madini.
ENEO LA UTAWALA:
Halmashauri ya Arusha ina tarafa tatu za Enaboishu, Moshono na Mukulat ikiwa na kata 27 za Bangata, Bwawani, Ikiding’a, Ilboru, Kimnyaki, Kiranyi, Kisongo, Kiutu, Laroi, Lemanyata, Matevesi, Mlangarini, Mwandet, Moivo, Musa, Nduruma
Ofisi Za Makao Makuu ya Wilaya ya Arusha zipo Kata ya Kiutu Kijiji cha Engorika eneo la Sekei Mkabala na Hoteli ya Kimataifa ya Mount Meru umbali wa takribani mita 300 kutoka barabara kuu ya Moshi – Arusha- Namanga.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Mission and Vision > Mission and Vision
pages.title: Mission and Vision
pages.text_en:
MISSION
To transform society by providing quality services and bringing about sustainable development for society by 2025.
VISION:
To provide quality services by using available resources effectively to bring about productivity and sustainable development for society.
pages.text_sw:
DIRA:
Kubadili Jamii kwa kutoa huduma bora na kuleta maendeleo endelevu kwa Jamii ifikapo 2025.
DHIMA:
Kutoa huduma bora kwa kutumia rasilimali zilizopo kwa ufanisi ili kuleta tija na maendeleo endelevu kwa Jamii.

pages.menu_path: About Us > Core Values > Core Values
pages.title: Core Values
pages.text_en:
CORE VALUES
Working together – Working together.
Transparency and accountability – making our vision and mission known, having a common understanding, building trust, being accountable to each other for our roles, etc.
Productive and efficient use of resources – Using available resources wisely, sharing scarce resources.
Anti-corruption – Making the Council a place free from the smell of corruption of any kind.
Excellent customer/citizen service – using respectful and generous language, providing satisfactory services.
Protection – having a sense of patriotism, and protecting Council assets.
Evidence-based decisions – having accurate and timely information, evidence.
Honesty and Confidentiality – Trusting each other and maintaining Council secrets.
Integrity and quality – being honest, caring and not giving up on customers is required, etc.
pages.text_sw:
MAADILI YA MSINGI
Kufanya kazi kwa umoja – Kufanya kazi kwa ushirikiano.
Uwazi na uwajibikaji – kutangaza maono na dira yetu vijulikane, kuwa na uelewa wa pamoja, kujenga uaminifu, kuwajibika kwa kila kwa nafasi zetu nk.
Matumizi ya rasilimali yenye tija na ufanisi–Kutumia rasilimali zilizopo kwa busara, kushirikiani kutumia rasilimali haba.
Kutokuwa na rushwa - Kufanya Halmashauri kuwa sehemu isiyo na harufu ya rushwa ya aina yoyote.
Huduma bora kwa wateja/wananchi–kutumia lugha za staha na ukarimu, kutoa huduma zenye kuridhisha.
Ulinzi – kuwa na moya wa uzalendo, na ulinzi wa mali za Halmashauri.
Maamuzi yenye ushahidi – kuwepo kwa taarifa sahihi na za wakati, ushahidi.
Uaminifu na Usiri – Kuaminiana na kutunza siri za Halmashauri.
Uadilifu na ubora–kuwa waadilifu, kujali na kutoamsaada kwa wateja unahitajika n.k.

pages.title: Industry, Trade and Investment
pages.text_en:
Objectives
To provide a business-friendly environment for the promotion of industries, trade, markets and investment development.
Responsibilities:
i. Coordinate the implementation of policies, laws, regulations and procedures relating to industries, trade, markets and investment.
ii. Promote industries, trade, markets and investment in the council.
iii. Plan and promote industrial and market areas in collaboration with other key stakeholders.
iv. Plan incentives to promote industries, trade, markets and investment.
v. Promote and develop small and medium enterprises
vi. Prepare investment proposals and investment projects.
vii. Strengthen private sector development initiatives.
viii. Establish and manage a database of industries, trade, markets and investment.
ix. Manage One Stop Business Centres.
x. Conduct research on investment promotion.
xi. Coordinate business platforms.
xii. To manage auction and market activities in the council.
xiii. To implement business development strategies for small traders and service providers.
xiv. To provide an enabling business and investment environment to promote trade and investment.
pages.text_sw:
Malengo
Kutoa mazingira rafiki ya biashara kwa ajili ya kukuza viwanda, biashara, masoko na maendeleo ya uwekezaji.
Majukumu:
i. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu zinazohusu viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
ii. Kukuza viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji katika halmashauri.
iii. Kupanga na kukuza maeneo ya viwanda na masoko kwa kushirikiana na wadau wengine muhimu.
iv. Kupanga vivutio kwa ajili ya kuhamasisha viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
v. Kukuza na kuendeleza biashara ndogo na za kati
vi. Kuandaa mapendekezo ya uwekezaji na miradi ya uwekezaji.
vii. Kuimarisha hatua za maendeleo ya sekta binafsi.
viii. Kuanzisha na kusimamia kanzidata (database) ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
ix. Kusimamia vituo vya huduma za biashara mahali pamoja (One Stop Business Centres).
x. Kufanya tafiti kuhusu uhamasishaji wa uwekezaji.
xi. Kuratibu majukwaa ya wafanyabiashara.
xii. Kusimamia shughuli za minada na masoko katika halmashauri.
xiii. Kutekeleza mikakati ya maendeleo ya biashara kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo na watoa huduma ndogo ndogo.
xiv. Kutoa mazingira wezeshi ya biashara na uwekezaji ili kukuza biashara na uwekezaji.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Pre and Primary Education
pages.title: Pre and Primary Education
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To plan and supervise the implementation of policies, laws and circulars relating to the provision of pre-primary education, primary education, special needs education and non-formal education.
Responsibilities:
i. To plan the availability, distribution and use of resources in primary schools.
ii. To supervise the implementation of continuous assessment and National Primary School Examinations.
iii. To supervise the provision of adult education and non-formal education at the primary and primary levels.
iv. To coordinate life skills education in primary schools.
v. To carry out needs assessments for special needs education, adult education and non-formal education.
vi. To advise on the establishment and maintenance of special needs education, adult education and non-formal education centres.
vii. To monitor the implementation of primary education plans and programmes.
viii. To create and maintain a database of pre-primary and primary education.
ix. Coordinate and manage sports activities in primary schools.
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kupanga na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na mizungumzo (circulars) inayohusu utoaji wa elimu ya awali, elimu ya msingi, elimu ya mahitaji maalumu na elimu isiyo rasmi.
Majukumu:
i. Kupanga upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali katika shule za msingi.
ii. Kusimamia utendaji wa tathmini endelevu na Mitihani ya Kitaifa ya Shule za Msingi.
iii. Kusimamia utoaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika ngazi ya awali na msingi.
iv. Kuratibu elimu ya ujuzi wa maisha (life skills education) katika shule za msingi.
v. Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu ya mahitaji maalumu, watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
vi. Kutoa ushauri kuhusu kuanzishwa na matengenezo ya vituo vya elimu ya mahitaji maalumu, watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
vii. Kufuatilia utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za elimu ya msingi.
viii. Kuunda na kudumisha kanzidata (database) ya elimu ya awali na msingi.
ix. Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za michezo katika shule za msingi.

pages.title: Secondary Education
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
Coordinate the implementation of policies, plans, laws and guidelines related to secondary education.
Responsibilities:
i. Supervise the implementation of continuous assessment and national examinations for Form Two, Four and Six.
ii. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of secondary education plans and programs.
iii. Supervise the provision of adult and non-formal education at the secondary level.
iv. Create and maintain a secondary education database.
v. Coordinate life skills education in secondary schools.
vi. Coordinate and supervise secondary school sports and games activities.
vii. Conduct needs assessments for special needs education, adult and non-formal education.
viii. Provide advice on the establishment and maintenance of special needs education, adult and non-formal education centers.
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, mipango, sheria na miongozo inayohusiana na elimu ya sekondari.
Majukumu:
i. Kusimamia utendaji wa tathmini endelevu na mitihani ya kitaifa ya kidato cha pili, cha nne na cha sita.
ii. Kufanya ufuatiliaji na tathmini ya utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za elimu ya sekondari.
iii. Kusimamia utoaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika ngazi ya sekondari.
iv. Kuunda na kudumisha kanzidata (database) ya elimu ya sekondari.
v. Kuratibu elimu ya ujuzi wa maisha (life skills education) katika shule za sekondari.
vi. Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za michezo na michezo ya shule za sekondari.
vii. Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu ya mahitaji maalumu, watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.
viii. Kutoa ushauri kuhusu kuanzishwa na matengenezo ya vituo vya elimu ya mahitaji maalumu, watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Health, Social Welfare and Nutrition Services
pages.title: Health, Social Welfare and Nutrition Services
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To provide quality health, social welfare and nutrition services for the well-being of the community.
Responsibilities:
i. To oversee the implementation of policies, laws and procedures related to the provision of health, social welfare and nutrition services.
ii. To prepare short and long term plans and programs for the health sector in the Council.
iii. To promote the participation of various stakeholders in health, social welfare and nutrition activities.
iv. To prepare and submit reports on health, social welfare and nutrition services to the relevant authorities.
v. To prepare strategies for the control of communicable and non-communicable diseases.
vi. To manage health, social welfare and nutrition projects.
vii. To manage and maintain a database related to health, social welfare and nutrition services.
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kutoa huduma bora za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe kwa ajili ya ustawi wa jamii.
Majukumu:
i. Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu zinazohusiana na utoaji wa huduma za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.
ii. Kuandaa mipango na programu za muda mfupi na mrefu kwa sekta ya afya katika Halmashauri.
iii. Kukuza ushiriki wa wadau mbalimbali katika shughuli za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.
iv. Kuandaa na kuwasilisha ripoti kuhusu huduma za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe kwa mamlaka zinazohusika.
v. Kuandaa mikakati ya udhibiti wa magonjwa yanayoambukiza na yasiyoambukiza.
vi. Kusimamia miradi ya afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.
vii. Kusimamia na kudumisha kanzidata (database) inayohusiana na huduma za afya, ustawi wa jamii na lishe.

pages.title: Community Development
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To oversee community development activities in Local Government Councils (LGAs).
Responsibilities:
i. To analyze, interpret and oversee the implementation of policies, laws and procedures related to community development.
ii. To enable communities to initiate, plan, implement and evaluate their own plans and projects.
iii. To prepare short and long term community development plans and projects at the local government authority level.
iv. To conduct research and make recommendations on how to address various development challenges in collaboration with the Ministry responsible for community development and other stakeholders.
v. To regulate and supervise the activities of microfinance service providers (microfinance) level four under the instructions of the Bank of Tanzania (BOT).
vi. To coordinate and supervise economic development activities for women, children and persons with disabilities.
vii. To coordinate the provision of training on poverty alleviation, AIDS, drugs and gender equality.
viii. Coordinate and monitor the activities of non-governmental organizations (NGOs) in community development.
ix. Coordinate and supervise community development activities in local government authorities.
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kusimamia shughuli za maendeleo ya jamii katika Halmashauri za Serikali za Mitaa (LGA).
Majukumu:
i. Kuchambua, kufasiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na taratibu zinazohusiana na maendeleo ya jamii.
ii. Kuwezesha jamii kuanzisha, kupanga, kutekeleza na kutathmini mipango na miradi yao wenyewe.
iii. Kuandaa mipango na miradi ya muda mfupi na mrefu ya maendeleo ya jamii katika ngazi ya mamlaka za serikali za mitaa.
iv. Kufanya tafiti na kutoa mapendekezo juu ya namna ya kushughulikia changamoto mbalimbali za maendeleo kwa kushirikiana na Wizara inayohusika na maendeleo ya jamii na wadau wengine.
v. Kudhibiti na kusimamia shughuli za watoa huduma za mikopo midogomidogo (microfinance) daraja la nne chini ya maagizo ya Benki Kuu ya Tanzania (BOT).
vi. Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za maendeleo ya kiuchumi kwa wanawake, watoto na watu wenye ulemavu.
vii. Kuratibu utoaji wa mafunzo juu ya kupunguza umaskini, UKIMWI, dawa za kulevya na usawa wa kijinsia.
viii. Kuratibu na kufuatilia shughuli za shughuli za mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali (NGOs) katika maendeleo ya jamii.
ix. Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za maendeleo ya jamii katika mamlaka za serikali a mitaa.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries
pages.title: Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To promote and encourage changes in the development of agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries.
Responsibilities:
i. To analyze, interpret and supervise the implementation of policies, laws and regulations related to agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries.
ii. To recommend standards and prices for goods and services derived from agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries.
iii. To prepare short and long term plans and programs for the development of agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries.
iv. To monitor the development and management of cooperatives in the Council.
v. To provide technical advice to stakeholders related to agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries.
vi. To prepare reports on agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries.
vii. To supervise the collection and control of revenues derived from agriculture, irrigation, livestock and fisheries.
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kukuza na kuhamasisha mabadiliko katika maendeleo ya kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
Majukumu:
i. Kuchambua, kufasiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria na kanuni zinazohusiana na kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
ii. Kupendekeza viwango na bei za bidhaa na huduma zinazotokana na kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
iii. Kuandaa mipango na programu za muda mfupi na mrefu za maendeleo ya kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
iv. Kufuatilia kukuza na utawala wa ushirika (cooperatives) katika Halmashauri.
v. Kutoa ushauri wa kiufundi kwa wadau wanaohusiana na kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
vi. Kuandaa ripoti kuhusu kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.
vii. Kusimamia ukusanyaji na udhibiti wa mapato yanayotokana na kilimo, umwagiliaji, mifugo na uvuvi.

pages.title: Planning and Coordination
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To provide expertise and services in planning, budgeting, monitoring and evaluation.
Responsibilities:
i. To prepare medium and long term strategies, plans, and budgets.
ii. To prepare and review the economic profile of the Local Government Authority.
iii. To coordinate the implementation of private sector participation.
iv. To coordinate disaster management in the Council.
v. To coordinate the activities of the Local Government Authority implemented by other institutions such as the land and water sectors.
vi. To prepare guidelines on research and innovation issues for the Local Government Authority.
vii. To coordinate research and innovation issues for evidence-based decision-making.
viii. To coordinate the management of innovation issues.
ix. To collaborate with national and international research institutions and statistical centers for the collection and exchange of research and innovation information.
Would you like help translating the titles of planning officers or are there other departmental responsibilities you need to continue with?
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kutoa utaalamu na huduma katika mipango, upangaji wa bajeti, ufuatiliaji na tathmini.
Majukumu:
i. Kuandaa mikakati, mipango, na bajeti za muda wa kati na mrefu.
ii. Kuandaa na kupitia wasifu wa kiuchumi wa Mamlaka ya Serikali ya Mitaa.
iii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa ushiriki wa sekta binafsi.
iv. Kuratibu usimamizi wa maafa katika Halmashauri.
v. Kuratibu shughuli za Mamlaka ya Serikali ya Mitaa zinazotekelezwa na taasisi nyingine kama vile sekta za ardhi na maji.
vi. Kuandaa miongozo kuhusu masuala ya utafiti na ubunifu kwa ajili ya Mamlaka ya Serikali ya Mitaa.
vii. Kuratibu masuala ya utafiti na ubunifu kwa ajili ya kufanya maamuzi yenye ushahidi.
viii. Kuratibu usimamizi wa masuala ya ubunifu.
ix. Kushirikiana na taasisi za utafiti za kitaifa na kimataifa pamoja na vituo vya takwimu kwa ajili ya kukusanya na kubadilishana taarifa za utafiti na ubunifu.
Je, ungependa msaada wa kutafsiri vyeo vya maafisa wa mipango au kuna majukumu ya idara nyingine unahitaji kuendelea nayo?

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Human Resources Administration and Management
pages.title: Human Resources Administration and Management
pages.text_en:
Objectives:
To provide expertise and services on human resource management and administrative matters to the Council.
Responsibilities:
i. Interpret the Public Service Regulations, the Standing Rules of the Public Service and other labor laws.
ii. Supervise the implementation of activities to promote ethics and principles of practice, including providing education on preventing corruption.
iii. Supervise and conduct the implementation of activities such as recruitment, selection, orientation training, and staff development, promotion, discipline, motivation, performance management, and general staff welfare.
iv. Ensure the effective and efficient management and use of human resources.
v. Coordinate the affairs of the Staff Council and trade unions.
vi. Supervise the preparation and implementation of policies, procedures, and consistent guidelines for employment, training and development, job placement, staff care, promotion, and performance management.
vii. Conduct regular reviews of human resources and a list of existing and required skills.
viii. Provide clerical services, receipt and dispatch of mail/parcels, and manage office records.
ix. Handle protocol issues.
x. Facilitate access to security, transportation, and other social services.
xi. Facilitate maintenance of office equipment, buildings, and office environment.
xii. Coordinate the implementation of activities to promote ethics and principles of practice.
xiii. Coordinate the implementation of various issues
xiv. Coordinate the implementation of private sector participation, improvement of operating systems and the Customer Service Agreement; and
xv. Provide advice on the structural efficiency of the office.
pages.text_sw:
Malengo:
Kutoa utaalamu na huduma kuhusu usimamizi wa rasilimali watu na masuala ya utawala kwa Halmashauri.
Majukumu:
i. Kufasiri Kanuni za Utumishi wa Umma, Kanuni za Kudumu za Utumishi wa Umma na sheria nyingine za kazi.
ii. Kusimamia utekelezaji wa shughuli za kukuza maadili na misingi ya kiutendaji, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa elimu ya kuzuia rushwa.
iii. Kusimamia na kuendesha utekelezaji wa shughuli kama vile ajira, uteuzi, mafunzo elekezi, na maendeleo ya wafanyakazi, upandishaji vyeo, nidhamu, motisha, usimamizi wa utendaji kazi, na ustawi wa wafanyakazi kwa ujumla.
iv. Kuhakikisha usimamizi na matumizi bora na yenye tija ya rasilimali watu.
v. Kuratibu masuala ya Baraza la Wafanyakazi na vyama vya wafanyakazi.
vi. Kusimamia uandaaji na utekelezaji wa sera, taratibu, na miongozo thabiti ya ajira, mafunzo na maendeleo, upangaji wa vituo vya kazi, utunzaji wa wafanyakazi, upandishaji vyeo, na usimamizi wa utendaji kazi.
vii. Kufanya ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa rasilimali watu na orodha ya ujuzi uliopo na unaohitajika.
viii. Kutoa huduma za masjala, upokeaji na usafirishaji wa barua/vifurushi, na kusimamia kumbukumbu za ofisi.
ix. Kushughulikia masuala ya itifaki.
x. Kuwezesha upatikanaji wa huduma za ulinzi, usafiri, na huduma nyinginezo za kijamii.
xi. Kuwezesha matengenezo ya vifaa vya ofisi, majengo, na mazingira ya ofisi.
xii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa shughuli za kukuza maadili na misingi ya kiutendaji.
xiii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa masuala anuai
xiv. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa ushiriki wa sekta binafsi, uboreshaji wa mifumo ya utendaji kazi na Mkataba wa Huduma kwa Mteja; na
xv. Kutoa ushauri kuhusu ufanisi wa kimuundo wa ofisi.

pages.title: Infrastrucre
pages.text_en:
Investors can establish industrial and commercial parks, whereby projects entail construction of roads, utility systems, fencing and supporting administrative and service blocks. Infrastructure development opportunities vary from development of wholly owned private industrial and/or commercial parks to various forms of Private Public Partnerships (PPP) with Communities, Private Developer and Arusha District Council.
> Construction of Modern Market at Sekei, the area for investment is owned by Arusha District Council, Sekei village and has 2.3 acres. The modern market’s expected to have seven storey building and it will cost an estimated amount of Tsh 35 billion. The area is surveyed and has title deed. Different socio-economic activities such as conference facilities, banking halls, departmental stores, restaurants, Curio shops, supermarkets and Car parking will be included when the project take off.
pages.text_sw:
Wawekezaji wanaweza kuanzisha mbuga za viwanda na biashara, ambapo miradi inahusisha ujenzi wa barabara, mifumo ya huduma, uzio na vitalu vya kiutawala na huduma vinavyounga mkono. Fursa za maendeleo ya miundombinu hutofautiana kuanzia uundaji wa mbuga za viwanda na/au biashara zinazomilikiwa kikamilifu hadi aina mbalimbali za Ushirikiano wa Kibinafsi wa Umma (PPP) na Jamii, Waendelezaji Binafsi na Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arusha.
> Ujenzi wa Soko la Kisasa huko Sekei, eneo la uwekezaji linamilikiwa na Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arusha, kijiji cha Sekei na lina ekari 2.3. Soko la kisasa linatarajiwa kuwa na jengo la ghorofa saba na litagharimu kiasi kinachokadiriwa cha Tsh bilioni 35. Eneo hilo limepimwa na lina hati miliki. Shughuli mbalimbali za kijamii na kiuchumi kama vile vifaa vya mikutano, kumbi za benki, maduka ya idara, migahawa, maduka ya Curio, maduka makubwa na maegesho ya magari zitajumuishwa wakati mradi utakapoanza.
